crossRefs.note: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this…
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

translations.web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
translations.bsb: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.
translations.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
translations.asv: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. And their voices prevailed.
